overview_description.description: Saferoad had led Middle East market with their innovative Telematics solutions, which go beyond managing fleets and their maintenance costs, up to optimize drivers’ utilization, ensure drivers safety, and help companies to reduce the OPEX and insurance expenses. The primary goal of Saferoad is to reduce accident number and to help the drivers in Saudi Arabia to enhance their driving behavior. The effective contribution of Saferoad technologies in regional economy let the company get many awards like IQPC, Arabian Venture Forum, Forbes, Tech­Tour.
